screenshots.title: Red Gum, the player HUD
screenshots.alt: First-person view across a red-earth clearing under gum trees with the compass, minimap, objective panel, health and ammunition on screen.
screenshots.note: Pre-alpha HUD; values are from a live bot match.

screenshots.title: Red Gum, the sniper tower
screenshots.alt: A timber watchtower standing among gum trees on red earth, seen from the ground over the barrel and optic of an A88.
screenshots.note: The tower is walkable by a ramp; foliage is a pre-alpha pass.

screenshots.title: Dry River, the ridge tower
screenshots.alt: A timber watchtower on a ridge above a red-earth slope with gum trees and an outstation in the distance.
screenshots.note: Pre-alpha; lighting and dressing are a work in progress.

screenshots.title: 3 ACR rifleman patrol
screenshots.alt: Three soldiers in Australian multicam-pattern uniform, helmets, headsets and webbing, moving past a white picket fence.
screenshots.note: Character models are in progress; the uniform texture is soft at close range.

screenshots.title: MAF section
screenshots.alt: A section of Murasian Armed Forces soldiers in red, olive and cream disruptive camouflage, helmets with goggles, carrying AK-pattern rifles.
screenshots.note: Fictional faction; uniform and gear are in progress.

screenshots.title: 3 ACR portrait
screenshots.alt: Close view of a soldier in a boonie hat with a boom microphone headset, white fence behind.

screenshots.title: MAF portrait
screenshots.alt: Close view of Murasian soldiers in camouflage helmets with goggles pushed up.

screenshots.title: A88 rifle
screenshots.alt: An A88 assault rifle with a Spectr optic, tan and black, against a blue sky.
screenshots.note: In-engine model of the 3 ACR service rifle (bullpup); a presentation view, not gameplay.

screenshots.title: A88G grenade launcher variant
screenshots.alt: A bullpup rifle with an under-barrel grenade launcher and optic, against a blue sky.
screenshots.note: In-engine model of the grenadier's rifle; a presentation view, not gameplay.

screenshots.title: A89 light support weapon
screenshots.alt: A black light machine gun with bipod, optic and carry handle, against a blue sky.
screenshots.note: In-engine model of the light support weapon; a presentation view, not gameplay.

screenshots.title: A4 carbine
screenshots.alt: A black AR-pattern carbine with an ACOG-style optic and rail handguard, against a blue sky.
screenshots.note: In-engine model of the carbine; a presentation view, not gameplay.

screenshots.title: A416 rifle
screenshots.alt: A black piston-driven rifle with an ACOG-style optic, long rail and adjustable stock, against a blue sky.
screenshots.note: In-engine model of the rifle; a presentation view, not gameplay.

screenshots.title: A25 marksman rifle
screenshots.alt: A tan marksman rifle with a thermal-style scope, rail handguard and fixed stock, against a blue sky.
screenshots.note: In-engine model of the designated marksman rifle; a presentation view, not gameplay.

screenshots.title: A9 pistol
screenshots.alt: A black semi-automatic pistol with a red front sight, against a blue sky.
screenshots.note: In-engine model of the sidearm; a presentation view, not gameplay.

screenshots.title: MAF marksman rifle (SVD)
screenshots.alt: A wooden-furniture marksman rifle with a four-times optic, against a blue sky.
screenshots.note: In-engine model of the Murasian Armed Forces marksman rifle; a presentation view, not gameplay.

screenshots.title: MAF machine gun (PKM)
screenshots.alt: A belt-fed general purpose machine gun with wooden stock and an olive ammunition box, against a blue sky.
screenshots.note: In-engine model of the Murasian Armed Forces machine gun; a presentation view, not gameplay.

screenshots.title: MAF assault rifle (AK pattern)
screenshots.alt: An AK-pattern assault rifle with red-brown wooden furniture and a curved magazine, against a blue sky.
screenshots.note: In-engine model of the Murasian Armed Forces rifle; a presentation view, not gameplay.
